title: Using the 2D Driver Console
summary: Start a session, operate controls, and observe the shared engine state in the 2D simulator.

steps.title: Open the 2D simulator
steps.body: Navigate to Simulators → 2D and start a session.

steps.title: Identify the controls
steps.body: Find the eight-position master handle, passenger-door buttons and emergency-brake input.

steps.title: Practice door closure
steps.body: At standstill with handle N, open the doors, close them and wait for All Doors Closed confirmation.

steps.title: Apply power or braking
steps.body: Request P1–P3 or B1–B3 and observe the simulated speed and handle indication.

steps.title: Review safety response
steps.body: Activate EB in a suitable practice session, stop, return to N, and request reset.

notes: Control inputs can be rejected by the Simulation Engine.
The 2D and 3D interfaces reflect the same active browser simulation session.
